scripts.build: bun run build:vite && bun run obfuscate
scripts.build:vite: bun run --cwd homeos-3d build && bun run --cwd homeos-store build
scripts.build:3d: bun run --cwd homeos-3d build && bun run obfuscate:3d
scripts.build:store: bun run --cwd homeos-store build && bun run obfuscate:store
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd homeos-3d typecheck && bun run --cwd homeos-store typecheck
